div.head: Hl 7[a]
div.ab: Gif man oþrum mæn feoh forstele, ⁊ se agend hit eft ætfó, geteme to cynges sele, gif he mæge, ⁊ þone ætgebrenge þe him sealde;
Gif man oþrum mæn feoh forstele, ⁊ se agend hit eft ætfo, geteme to cynges sele gif he mæge, ⁊ þone æt gebrenge þe him sealde.
If a person steals property from another person, and the owner afterwards takes possession of it, let him [the accused] vouch in the king’s hall, if he is able, and bring him who sold it to him.
If one man steals property from another, and the owner afterwards reclaims it, he [who is in possession] shall bring it to the king’s residence, if he can, and produce the man who sold it him.

If anyone steals the property of another man, and the owner afterwards attaches it, he [the accused] is to vouch to warranty at the king’s hall, if he can, and produce him who sold it to him; if he cannot do that, he is to relinquish it, and the owner to succeed to it.

Wenn einer einem andern Manne [bewegliches] Gut stiehlt, und es späterhin dieser Eigenthümer [im Anefang] fasst, [so] ziehe [der verklagte Besitzer] die Gewähr zur Königshalle, wenn er kann, indem er denjenigen herbeibringt, welcher es ihm verkauft hat;

If someone steals [movable] property from another man, and afterwards this owner seizes it [by attachment], [then] let [the accused possessor] vouch to warranty at the king’s hall, if he can, by bringing forward the one who sold it to him;
div.note: Whitelock translates Hl 7 as one clause, which the sheet divides into rows 7[a], 7[b]; her translation of the whole is given here, in the first row.
